newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar spends day in 30 cents range.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar spends day in 30 cents range.

text.p: White sugar futures passed a slow day with prices in the most active positions trading within a 30 cents a tonne range.
Traders said that the current dearth of news from the physical market coupled with the absence of any lead from New York, closed for Independence Day, made for very quiet trading conditions.
At the close near August was trading at $319.20 a tonne, down $0.70 from Thursday, and total turnover was 444 lots.
With the New York market shut, the London market closed early at 1600 GMT.
Paris white sugar 45 ICUMSA was likewise quiet with prices $0.10 lower and turnover just 12 lots. The 100 ICUMSA contract was tradeless.
